item.description: Important: This is an Inline Water Heater Upgrade only You must purchase a compatible Trojan or Beaufort whirlpool bath separately, then add this heater for factory fitting.Enjoy Longer, Hotter BathsExtend your relaxing soak with the Koller 1.5 kW Inline Water Heater. No, it is designed to maintain temperature while the whirlpool is running, not to heat a cold bath.Can it share the same electrical supply as the pump?
